## Notes

- Land Unit Reinforcement and Withdrawal Schedules: 4.43a Commonwealth (jp2 113-114), 4.43b Axis (jp2 144-145). Transcribed in full, Game-Turns 1-111.
- A unit named is the counter on its OA sheet together with the units assigned to it there, as in the scenario set-ups (59.2).
- The Axis schedule has no entries before Game-Turn 9.
- Read twice (archive.org scan; community 300 dpi chart PDFs): Game-Turns 1-6 agree row for row; Game-Turns 7-38 (109 printed entries) and 39-111 (169) agree apart from how a few lists were split and one truck figure (Game-Turn 75 OpStage 3, settled from the scan: 6 heavy).
- A unit that returns after a withdrawal is an 'arrives' row with a note. Withdrawals print a transport figure (Tpt: a/b) in place of a truck breakdown; it is kept in the row's notes.
- Rows that bring only trucks or tank points and no counter: Axis trucks at 27/3, 28/2, 31/1 and 38/2 (OpStage/Game-Turn order reversed here: Game-Turn 27 OpStage 3 and so on), and the Commonwealth Tiger convoy at Game-Turn 32 OpStage 3. They are listed in unplaced.
- Where the schedule and a unit's OA sheet print different arrivals (the 5th Panzer Regiment group, the 2 MG Bn, the 102nd Anti-tank Regt, the 22nd Armoured Bde HQ, the 78th Field Regt, and the 22nd Guards Brigade whose sheet prints none) the row keeps the schedule's date and says so; both charts were read twice.
